notes: §2002:14.8.36.3 GR16 with §2002:14.5.12.1.1 (a RESUME means the declarative does not complete normally). A USE procedure run by an OPEN in the input procedure ends in RESUME AT L1-LANDED, so the SORT is terminated and the next SORT does not run inside the old range: L1-USE=35 / L1-LANDED / L2-OUT=Y / L2-OUT=Z / L2-AFTER / DONE. The --std 2002 run matched, and a mutant that leaves the SORT active loses the L2-OUT lines.
